text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 15 · 复古旅行海报 · 沙海上的蒸汽驿站 · 赭红 / 深蓝 / 沙金.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Vintage mid-century travel-poster illustration of a lonely steam train station among vast desert dunes, copper canopy and small empty parked locomotive, bold simplified geometry, screenprinted paper texture, ochre-red dunes and navy shadows with pale golden sky, no typography, no title, purely full-bleed narrative environment.
Visual medium: retro poster; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit the supplied multi-view sheet. Keep original panels A, B and D exactly unchanged in scene design, color, empty environment and architecture. DELETE panel C (bottom left), whose water tower is on the wrong side of the railway. Rearrange only A B D into a clean balanced THREE-panel landscape sheet, relabel A B C. Do not invent views. Preserve the ochre and navy vintage travel-poster style. No people or animals.
